name: walk
about: Front/back walk with weight, 8 keys: 0 contact, 1 down, 2 pass (left leg up), 3 up, 4 contact, 5 down, 6 pass (right leg up), 7 up. The body dips 2 px on each step; the head stays fixed on the body (a late head slides the chin over the collar); arms stay with the body (no shoulder swing), hands trail slightly. Legs hang from the torso, so a planted leg cancels the torso's dip to stay put.
